H6500.def: a primitive root; to bear fruit:--be fruitful.

H6501.def: or pereh (Jeremiah 2:24) {peh'-reh}; from «06500» in the secondary sense of running wild; the onager:--wild (ass).

H6503.def: or Parvar {par-vawr'}; of foreign origin; Parbar or Parvar, a quarter of Jerusalem:--Parbar, suburb.

H6504.def: a primitive root; to break through, i.e. spread or separate (oneself):--disperse, divide, be out of joint, part, scatter (abroad), separate (self), sever self, stretch, sunder.

H6505.def: from «06504»; a mule (perhaps from his lonely habits):--mule.

H6507.def: feminine passive participle of «06504»; something separated, i.e. a kernel:--seed.

H6508.def: of foreign origin; a park:--forest, orchard.

H6509.def: a primitive root; to bear fruit (literally or figuratively):--bear, bring forth (fruit), (be, cause to be, make) fruitful, grow, increase.

H6510.def: feminine of «06499»; a heifer:--cow, heifer, kine.

H6511.def: the same as «06510»; Parah, a place in Palestine:--Parah.

H6512.def: from «06331»; a hole (as broken, i.e. dug):--+ mole. Compare «02661».

H6514.def: or Priyda {per-ee-daw'}; from «06504»; dispersion; Peruda or Perida, one of "Solomon's servants":--Perida, Peruda.

H6515.def: passive participle of «06524»; blossomed; Paruach, an Israelite:--Paruah.

H6516.def: of foreign origin; Parvajim, an Oriental region:--Parvaim.

H6517.et: pass part of (06565) in the sense of spreading out [compare (06524)]
H6517.def: passive participle of «06565» in the sense of spreading out (compare «06524»); a skillet (as flat or deep):--pan, pot.

H6518.et: from an unused root meaning to separate, i.e. decide
H6518.def: from an unused root meaning to separate, i.e. decide; a chieftain:--village.

H6519.def: from the same as «06518»; an open country:--(unwalled) town (without walls), unwalled village.

H6520.def: from the same as «06518»; magistracy, i.e. leadership (also concretely, chieftains):--village.

H6522.def: for «06521»; inhabitant of the open country; a Perizzite, one of the Canaanitish tribes:--Perizzite.

H6524.def: a primitive root; to break forth as a bud, i.e. bloom; generally, to spread; specifically, to fly (as extending the wings); figuratively, to flourish:--X abroad, × abundantly, blossom, break forth (out), bud, flourish, make fly, grow, spread, spring (up).

H6525.def: from «06524»; a calyx (natural or artificial); generally, bloom:--blossom, bud, flower.

H6527.def: a primitive root; to scatter words, i.e. prate (or hum):--chant.

H6528.def: from «06527»; a stray or single berry:--grape.

H6529.def: from «06509»; fruit (literally or figuratively):--bough, ((first-)) fruit((-ful)), reward.

H6530.def: from «06555»; violent, i.e. a tyrant:--destroyer, ravenous, robber.

H6531.et: from an unused root meaning to break apart
H6531.def: from an unused root meaning to break apart; fracture, i.e. severity:--cruelty, rigour.

H6532.et: act part of the same as (06531)
H6532.def: feminine active participle of the same as «06531»; a separatrix, i.e. (the sacred) screen:--vail.

H6534.def: of Persian origin; Parmashta, a son of Haman:--Parmasta.

H6535.def: of uncertain derivation; Parnak, an Israelite:--Parnach.

H6536.def: a primitive root; to break in pieces, i.e. (usually without violence) to split, distribute:--deal, divide, have hoofs, part, tear.

H6538.def: from «06536»; a claw; also a kind of eagle:--claw, ossifrage.

H6539.def: of foreign origin; Paras (i.e. Persia), an Eastern country, including its inhabitants:--Persia, Persians.

H6541.def: feminine of «06538»; a claw or split hoof:--claw, (cloven-)footed, hoof.

H6542.def: patrial from «06539»; a Parsite (i.e. Persian), or inhabitant of Peres:--Persian.

H6544.def: a primitive root; to loosen; by implication, to expose, dismiss; figuratively, absolve, begin:--avenge, avoid, bare, go back, let, (make) naked, set at nought, perish, refuse, uncover.

H6546.et: fem of (06545) (in the sense of beginning)
H6546.def: feminine of «06545» (in the sense of beginning); leadership (plural concretely, leaders):--+ avenging, revenge.

H6547.def: of Egyptian derivation; Paroh, a general title of Egyptian kings:--Pharaoh.

H6548.def: of Egyptian derivation; Paroh- Chophra, an Egyptian king:--Pharaoh-hophra.

H6549.def: or Parpoh Nkow {par-o' nek-o'}; of Egyptian derivation; Paroh-Nekoh (or -Neko), an Egyptian king: --Pharaoh-necho, Pharaoh-nechoh.

H6550.def: probably from «06544» and «06211»; a flea (as the isolated insect):--flea.

H6551.def: the same as «06550»; Parosh, the name of our Israelite:--Parosh, Pharosh.

H6552.def: from «06546»; chieftaincy; Pirathon, a place in Palestine:--Pirathon.

H6553.pos:
Pirathonite = see Pirathon "princely"
  1. an inhabitant of Pirathon
H6553.def: or Pirathoniy {pir-aw-tho-nee'}; patrial from «06552»; a Pirathonite or inhabitant of Pirathon:--Pirathonite.

H6554.et: probably from (06565) in the sense of rushing
H6554.def: probably from «06565» in the sense of rushing; rapid; Parpar, a river of Syria:--Pharpar.

H6555.def: a primitive root; to break out (in many applications, direct and indirect, literal and figurative):--X abroad, (make a) breach, break (away, down, -er, forth, in, up), burst out, come (spread) abroad, compel, disperse, grow, increase, open, press, scatter, urge.

H6556.def: from «06555»; a break (literally or figuratively):--breach, breaking forth (in), × forth, gap.

H6557.def: the same as «06556»; Perets, the name of two Israelites:--Perez, Pharez.

H6558.def: patronymically from «06557»; a Partsite (collectively) or descendants of Perets:--Pharzites.

H6559.def: plural of «06556»; breaks; Peratsim, a mountain in Palestine:--Perazim.

H6560.def: from «06556» and «05798»; break of Uzza; Perets-Uzza, a place in Palestine:--Perez-uzza.

H6561.def: a primitive root; to break off or crunch; figuratively, to deliver:--break (off), deliver, redeem, rend (in pieces), tear in pieces.

H6563.def: from «06561»; rapine; also a fork (in roads):--crossway, robbery.

H6564.def: from «06561»; soup (as full of crumbed meat):--broth. See also «04832».

H6565.def: a primitive root; to break up (usually figuratively, i.e. to violate, frustrate:--X any ways, break (asunder), cast off, cause to cease, × clean, defeat, disannul, disappoint, dissolve, divide, make of none effect, fail, frustrate, bring (come) to nought, × utterly, make void.

H6566.def: a primitive root; to break apart, disperse, etc.:--break, chop in pieces, lay open, scatter, spread (abroad, forth, selves, out), stretch (forth, out).

H6567.def: a primitive root; to separate, literally (to disperse) or figuratively (to specify); also (by implication) to wound:-- scatter, declare, distinctly, shew, sting.

H6570.def: the same as «06569»; Peresh, an Israelite:--Peresh.

H6571.def: from «06567»; a steed (as stretched out to a vehicle, not single nor for mounting (compare «05483»)); also (by implication) a driver (in a chariot), i.e. (collectively) cavalry:--horseman.

H6572.def: or pathshegen {path-sheh'-gen}; of foreign origin; a transcript:--copy.

H6574.et: perhaps by compounding (06567) and (06504) (in the sense of straddling) [compare (06576)]
H6574.def: perhaps by compounding «06567» and «06504» (in the sense of straddling) (compare «06576»); the crotch (or anus):--dirt.

H6576.et: a root apparently formed by compounding (06567) and that of (06518) [compare (06574)]
H6576.def: a root apparently formed by compounding «06567» and that of 6518 (compare «06574»); to expand:--spread.

H6577.def: of Persian origin; Parshandatha, a son of Haman:--Parshandatha.

H6578.et: from an unused root meaning to break forth
H6578.def: from an unused root meaning to break forth; rushing; Perath (i.e. Euphrates), a river of the East:--Euphrates.

H6579.def: of Persian origin; a grandee:--(most) noble, prince.

H6580.et: probably from an unused root meaning to disintegrate
H6580.def: probably from an unused root meaning to disintegrate; stupidity (as a result of grossness or of degeneracy):--extremity.

H6582.def: a primitive root; to tear in pieces:--pull in pieces.

H6583.def: probably from «06582»; liberation; Pashchur, the name of four Israelites:--Pashur.

H6584.def: a primitive root; to spread out (i.e. deploy in hostile array); by analogy, to strip (i.e. unclothe, plunder, flay, etc.):--fall upon, flay, invade, make an invasion, pull off, put off, make a road, run upon, rush, set, spoil, spread selves (abroad), strip (off, self).

H6585.def: a primitive root; to stride (from spreading the legs), i.e. rush upon:--go.

H6586.et: a primitive root [identical with (06585) through the idea of expansion]
H6586.def: a primitive root (identical with «06585» through the idea of expansion); to break away (from just authority), i.e. trespass, apostatize, quarrel:--offend, rebel, revolt, transgress(-ion, -or).

H6588.def: from «06586»; a revolt (national, moral or religious):--rebellion, sin, transgression, trespass.

H6589.def: a primitive root; to dispart (the feet or lips), i.e. become licentious:--open (wide).

H6593.et: from the same as (06580) as in the sense of comminuting
H6593.def: from the same as «06580» as in the sense of comminuting; linen (i.e. the thread, as carded):--flax, linen.

H6594.def: feminine of «06593»; flax; by implication, a wick:--flax, tow.

H6596.et: from an unused root meaning to open
H6596.def: or pothah (Ezek. 13:19) {po-thaw'}; from an unused root meaning to open; a hole, i.e. hinge or the female pudenda:--hinge, secret participle

H6598.def: of Persian origin; a dainty:--portion (provision) of meat.

H6599.def: of Persian origin; a (judicial) sentence:--decree, sentence.
